name: KB Swing EMOM
description: Every minute on the minute: 15 swings.

name: Goblet Squat + Swing Ladder
description: Rounds of 21, 15, then 9 goblet squats and swings.

name: Bag Burnout
description: 1 min all-out on the heavy bag, 1 min easy.

name: Push-Up + Bag Flurry
description: 10 push-ups, then 30 sec fast straight punches.

name: Lateral Raise Burnout
description: Light dumbbells (8 lb start). 50 reps per round, 100 total. Logs weight.

name: Farmer Carry
description: Heaviest bells or dumbbells. Walk 40 yd, rest 60 sec.

name: Suitcase Carry
description: One heavy bell, 40 yd each side. Stay tall.

name: Curl + Push-Up Pump
description: 10 curls then 10 push-ups, no rest between.

name: Swing + Burpee Ladder
description: Round 1: 1 burpee and 10 swings. Add one burpee each round.

name: Treadmill Sprints
description: 30 sec fast at 6-8% incline, 60 sec walk.

name: KB Complex
description: 6 swings, 6 cleans, 6 presses, 6 squats. Rest 90 sec.
